materiality.rule: a dedicated slice needs >= 3 % of a named weighted denominator (default KME-L weighted; CPP-D-W7 for CPP-corpus claims)
materiality.exceptions: correctness, authority, security, horizontal primitive: argued separately in the pillar's evidence; an exception never lowers the threshold for another pillar
materiality.displacement: a saving is realized only when displaced work is measured on the same denominator; otherwise it is an interval or UNKNOWN
materiality.transfer: a performance guarantee promoted to CBR needs a second, materially independent workload

KME-L.weighting: input 1 + cache_read 0.1 + cache_write 2 + output 5 (CE weighting). ESTIMATE of relative token burden, not price, not the Owner's meter.
KME-L.attribution_range: proportional attribution by KME tool-call share gives 3824.34 USD-eq over all 557 scanned local sessions; the true KME burden lies in [3824, 5850]

KME-G.note: 151 a7 sessions with zero API calls = the Login-expired relaunch loop of 2026-10-02

CPP-D-W7.note: CE frozen denominator D-W7 (CPP corpus 7 d to 2026-10-02), referenced, never re-measured here

pillars.name: optimizer lifecycle (reopened from IC gen1 M): durable priced opportunity rows, lifecycle, autonomy envelope, per-opportunity budget
pillars.rule: IC-gen2 M (reopened; supersedes gen1 M 'dispositions only' for this generation, gen1 frozen M untouched) closes IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED only when, each with a command: (1) opportunity rows live in the existing ledger convention, no new database, and carry evidence, scope, workload class, frequency, current cost, hypothesis, owner search result, predicted dividend, build + proof + carrying cost, risk, reversibility, champion, challenger, status, retirement condition and realized dividend; (2) lifecycle states observed, priced, shadow, canary, certified, promoted plus rejected, narrowed, superseded, retired, with a test that refuses a direct jump to promoted; (3) the autonomy envelope (derived, index, cache and reversible tooling autonomous; architecture, authority, global settings and irreversible actions to the owner bundle) is driven from both sides by tests; (4) every opportunity has a budget and a branch whose predicted payback deteriorates is re-evaluated or stopped and recorded; (5) a predicted dividend is never labelled realized, and the measured overhead of index refresh plus detectors stays below the realized savings, both with commands; (6) the Production Reality probe shows real CLI -> real substrate -> measured effect. Any other ending needs a falsification artifact naming [M] (IC-gen2).

pillars.name: usage_index v5 substrate
pillars.rule: IC-gen2 O closes IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED only when: (1) tools/usage_index.py schema v5 adds tool events (tool, input hash, path, result bytes), cwd, project/workstream attribution (mixed allowed) and realpath + content identity via tools/tis_observed.py store_identity; (2) the v4 -> v5 migration re-reads zero already-ingested files, measured; (3) six negative controls go red when they should: a mixed-project session attributed to both projects, two distinct histories not merged, a junction alias counted once, _archived handled by a declared rule, a parser failure surfaced and never a silent zero, an empty population refusing a verdict; (4) population parity with the frozen KME-L denominator (102 sessions / 34,871 calls / cache_read 11,549,646,300) on the GEX44 corpus copy /home/kobii/kme-corpus/projects, dedup reconciled to the unit, labelled plane gex44; (5) refresh cost (wall, bytes) measured for a cold build and for a delta. Any other ending needs a falsification artifact naming [O] (IC-gen2).

pillars.name: KME-L challenger (index-first access plan)
pillars.rule: IC-gen2 P closes IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED only when: (1) the kme_pillars access plan is certified index -> project-scoped raw -> global raw only on an explicit cross-project question, a guard failure deopts with a logged reason, and invalidation is keyed on source watermark, parser version, attribution version and metric definition; (2) the 7 KME-L measurement files (D, E, F, G, H, I, L) reproduce identically from the challenger; (3) a champion vs scoped vs challenger table (wall, raw bytes, unique bytes, raw files opened, cross-project bytes exposed) is measured against frozen champion run5 and run6; (4) a KME-only query opens zero CostaLuz bytes and a negative control proves that check can fail; (5) changing a source or the parser version invalidates exactly the affected closure; (6) the certified path is promoted through modules/tower/ratchet.promote at project scope, a fresh worker asked a KME question without naming the index takes the index path (the path log shows the hit), and bypassing the index turns a gate red. Allowed loss (D-OQ4): if the challenger does not beat the scoped path on repeated queries, P closes FALSIFIED_OR_REJECTED_BY_EVIDENCE with a falsification artifact naming [P] (IC-gen2) that carries the table; that is a valid pre-registered outcome, not a failure. A narrowed challenger closes IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED only for the narrowed scope named in its reason and evidence.

pillars.name: generic opportunity detectors + discovery eval
pillars.rule: IC-gen2 Q closes IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED only when: (1) detectors extend CO-12 (modules/cognitive_os/co_12_telemetry.py record_signal) with no new top-level component and cover read amplification (same path + content read N times), scan amplification (bytes read / evidence consumed), a repeated identical command with unchanged inputs, a retry without causal delta, and a model call answering a deterministic question; (2) counters are cheap and always on, with detail only on anomaly; (3) the discovery eval finds the KME-L hotspot without any KME-specific signature, finds one seeded hotspot, does not flag one known no-optimization case, rejects one low-ROI case, and reports detected / missed / false positive counts; (4) detector overhead is measured. Any other ending needs a falsification artifact naming [Q] (IC-gen2).

pillars.name: second workload taken by the loop
pillars.rule: IC-gen2 R closes IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED only when: (1) the loop itself raises, prices and accepts the next candidate from detector output without the Founder naming it (expected tools/sovereign_miner.py, the only automatic full-corpus parse; the detectors' first-ranked candidate wins if reality offers better, with the ranking recorded); (2) shadow agreement is measured, a canary runs on the GEX44 corpus copy, and certification carries a realized dividend measured on a named denominator; (3) the laptop scheduled-task deploy is an owner-bundle [R] (IC-gen2) line; (4) family-scope promotion of the anti-rescan principle through modules/tower/ratchet.promote happens only if this transfer evidence supports it. Any other ending needs a falsification artifact naming [R] (IC-gen2).

opportunities.title: pp_install judged by commit-hash ancestry only: a -x cherry-pick of the floor reads stale
opportunities.schema_note: provisional until ROADMAP Phase 4 formalizes the opportunity schema
opportunities.frequency: every arm or re-arm of a relay on the default GEX44 env
opportunities.current_cost: pp_install_stale false positive: each re-arm of the default env needs exit 0 or a new Owner waiver (STATE.md decision, 2026-10-05)
opportunities.hypothesis: accepting an exact cherry-pick trailer of the floor removes the false NOT_READY without accepting unrelated histories

predicted_dividend.unit: Owner waivers avoided per default-env re-arm
predicted_dividend.basis: predicted from the measured false positive; not yet observed on the live install

carrying_cost.unit: s per preflight (median delta, 0.047 s pre-fix vs 0.059 s fixed)
carrying_cost.detail: verdicts differ (NOT_READY vs READY): an indication for one host, not a benchmark; no token or money figure is claimed

opportunities.risk: a trailer asserts a pick, it does not prove identical code (see evidence Honest limits)
opportunities.reversibility: revert the plan 00-02 fix commits; the live install only changes through its normal fast-forward sync
opportunities.challenger: ancestry OR exact cherry-pick trailer OR equal patch-id where the floor object exists
opportunities.next_transition: canary: the live GEX44 install's own preflight reads READY after its normal fast-forward sync
opportunities.retirement_condition: the floor commit itself is in the live install's ancestry (the pick path is then unused)
